expectations.name: executable
expectations.intent: the protocol can be executed to completion

expectations.name: secret_A
expectations.intent: na remains secret from A's perspective
required_events:
Reveal exception for
  compromised long-term keys

expectations.name: secret_B
expectations.intent: na remains secret from B's perspective
required_events:
Reveal exception for
  compromised long-term keys

expectations.name: secrecy_PFS_A
expectations.intent: na remains secret even after A's long-term key is compromised (forward secrecy)
required_events:
after-the-fact
  Reveal(pk(ltkB)) is allowed and should not be excluded
